resolutions.supersession: Persist the replacement first; supersede the predecessor only after confirmed replacement delivery.
resolutions.deduplication: Reserve by tenant and handoff while processing; mark complete only after durable effects; semantic duplicate identity includes incident, authoritative assessment, and change type.
resolutions.deliveryFailure: Use delivery_failed when every actionable channel fails or is unconfigured; accepted remains delivering until confirmed.
resolutions.healthVocabulary: Dependency checks use healthy, unhealthy, or not_configured; audit storage reports healthy, buffering, or degraded; overall unhealthy returns HTTP 503.
resolutions.pipelineBudget: Stages 1 through 9 total 40 seconds; stages 4 through 7 total 24 seconds; the 60-second end-to-end budget leaves 20 seconds for queue and orchestration overhead.
resolutions.smsTruncation: Preserve the action and help URL; truncate descriptive body first; calculate segments using GSM-7 or UCS-2 encoding.
resolutions.embeddingOutage: Retain otherwise-safe generated text, record back-translation as unmeasured, and do not apply a fabricated quality penalty.
resolutions.escalation: Spec 018 is authoritative: Emergency Warning uses 5 minutes, lower tiers use 15 minutes, and exhaustion never auto-approves.
resolutions.configurationInventory: The implementation and generated configuration reference are authoritative; documentation must not assert a fixed variable count.
resolutions.templateSelection: Template identity requires language_code, hazard_type, severity, and alert_type; an explicitly labelled approved generic alias may cover a missing hazard-specific combination.
resolutions.runtime: The standalone FastAPI communication service is the compatibility runtime; MAF may invoke it through an adapter but must not replace its safety, approval, persistence, or delivery boundaries.
